The full source text reads: 'שָׁבוּעוֹת הוּא רְפוּאָה לְהָרֵאָה, כִּי חֲמִשָּׁה כַּנְפֵי רֵאָה כְּנֶגֶד חֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה (תיקון כה), וּבְשָׁבוּעוֹת מְקַבְּלִין הַתּוֹרָה, יְכוֹלִין לְקַבֵּל חִיּוּת חָדָשׁ'

The teaching's argument is a straightforward eitza chain: Shavuot → receiving Torah → healing the lung / new vitality. The numerical correspondence (5 lobes / 5 books) is structural supporting evidence for the eitza, not a bechina cluster. With fewer than 3 bechina-linked concepts, no new package can be proposed.
